## Chief Justice of India

![Chief Justice of India](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3ec0490f1f4972d133619a60c30f3559e/uploads/2023/10/2025102910.jpg)

Hon'ble **Justice Surya Kant**

Chief Justice of India

**(DoB.) :** 10-02-1962

**Term of Office :**(DoA) 24-05-2019 to (DoR) 09-02-2027

Born on 10th February, 1962 at Hisar (Haryana) in a middle class family.

Sworn in as the Chief Justice of India on 24th November, 2025.

Due to retire on 09th February, 2027.
